reviews.text: Absolute 5-star service! Karenswood treated prince like family. He came home happy and tired out from all the fun. The staff is warm, professional, and attentive. Highly recommend to anyone looking for top-notch care for their dog!
Our George always comes home happy and healthy couldnt ask for anymore than that they are brilliant
Been taking my dogs for over 20 years,  absolutely brilliant kennels, lovely staff
Excellent professional service with quality products that are second to none.
Highly recommend they had my 2 xl bully's both came back very happy,
Used these kennels for years now never go anywhere else dogs are well cared for & well looked after. Rocco my EBT loves to go there
Absolutely brilliant would highly recommend taking your dog here 👍 …

Expert care and a happy dog! We recently left our dog, Coco, at Karenswood and couldn’t be happier with the experience. It’s clear the team truly understands dog behavior; they even had me wait in a specific spot during drop-off to ensure Coco didn't feel anxious watching me leave. It’s those small, thoughtful details that set them apart! Coco loved the incredible on-site dog park and came home happy and relaxed. It’s such a relief to find a kennel that treats your pet like family. I highly recommend them.

The most caring, professional dog kennels I’ve ever been lucky enough to book.

So grateful to Kirstie for supporting me with my dog today for a couple of nights

On arrival Ellie mirrored Kirsties through and attentive approach to getting Polo settled in and helping me understand how the kennels works.

By far the best first impression I’ve ever had, feel as if my anxious pup will be given all the care he needs and that we have found a safe space to help him grow in confidence

Thank you all so much, see ya Sunday ✌️
